relaxed.name: Relaxed
relaxed.feel: Build and enjoy. The bank warns but never forecloses.
relaxed.blurb: A bigger, cheaper loan, more visitors, fewer bad events and cheaper bills. Overdrafts still cost interest and the Bank will warn you, but the park never closes.

standard.name: Standard
standard.feel: Fair but real. You can lose, and the game tells you why.
standard.blurb: The tuned game: a $25,000 loan at 4%, three quarters of grace before foreclosure, and every number as balanced.

classic.name: Classic
classic.feel: The shoestring. One quarter of grace and no room for a bare opening.
classic.blurb: A $10,000 loan at 10% with one quarter of grace, fewer visitors, dearer wages and feed, more bad events and easier breakouts. Play well from day one or the bank takes the park.

_notes: Phase 2 difficulty modes. Every mode is a complete parameter set layered on balance.json / staff.json / food.json / fences.json / events.json; Standard is exactly the tuned game (all multipliers 1.0, event_frequency 0.8 as before). Keys: start_loan (opening cash = opening debt), apr (quarterly interest = debt x apr / 4), debt_cap_base + debt_cap_networth_factor (cap = base + factor x park assets; borrowed cash never raises it, overdrawn cash lowers it), grace_quarters (consecutive quarter closes with net debt above the cap before foreclosure), foreclosure_enabled (false: the count still runs and the Bank + status bar show a Bank warning, but the park never closes), attendance_mult (x base demand), event_frequency (x events.json daily_chance; Relaxed = Standard x 0.7, Classic = Standard x 1.2), food_cost_mult (x every food.json unit cost, seeds included), salary_mult (x every staff.json salary), breakout_mult (x the daily breakout chance from fences.json), morale_softening (true: the M2.6 halved morale penalties in staff.json as written; false: penalties x staff.json morale.unsoftened_penalty_mult, the pre-M2.6 bleed). Old saves carry no mode and load as Standard. History: debt_cap_base 60000 -> 88000 -> 100000 -> 60000 (see the M2.6/M3 notes in git history: the $100,000 rope only existed for the retired day-1 splurge scenario). Relaxed debt_cap_base 80000 -> 60000 (same as Standard): with foreclosure off the cap only sets borrowing room and the Bank warning, and at 80000 one slow-bleed seed never crossed it.
